senses.definition_en: unless

examples.english: The job took me a long time so I had to cut my losses and tell them that I wasn't going to take those kinds of jobs anymore, unless they paid me better.
examples.ref: 2010, Adela Robles-Sáez, 3,000 locuciones verbales y combinaciones frecuentes, Georgetown University Press, →ISBN, page 71:
examples.text: El trabajo me salió muy largo así que tuve que cortar por lo sano y decirles que ya no iba a aceptar más ese tipo de trabajos, a menos que me pagaran mejor.
examples.translation: The job took me a long time so I had to cut my losses and tell them that I wasn't going to take those kinds of jobs anymore, unless they paid me better.

examples.english: Many years ago I wrote the script for Pussycat [1965] ^([sic]) and they made a terrible, though very popular, movie of it. I've never written a script again unless I was the director.
examples.ref: 2023 September 18, Jacinto Antón, quoting Woody Allen, “Woody Allen: “La infidelidad sólo es buena en la ficción””, in El País:
examples.text: Hace muchos años escribí el guion de Pussycat [1965]^([sic]) e hicieron con él una película terrible, aunque muy popular. Nunca más he escrito un guion a menos que yo fuera el director.
examples.translation: Many years ago I wrote the script for Pussycat [1965] ^([sic]) and they made a terrible, though very popular, movie of it. I've never written a script again unless I was the director.

glosses: unless
